evidence.quote: Most Dwarf words have several meanings.
evidence.claim: Context selects the documented colour, stone and tool senses. New symbolic combinations are a Forthammer naming adaptation; no full tunnel-naming grammar is claimed.
Duk carries size constraints and is not a safe generic word for every tunnel. Duraz instead supplies a symbolic stone image without reporting actual geology.

evidence.quote: Waste rock or spoil left by miners’ excavations
evidence.claim: Grint supplies an explicitly excavation-related symbolic image. Grund is hammer. Girt is excluded because it asserts a broad tunnel with plenty of headroom.
Ungdrin names the Underway and must not turn a newly dug generic DF tunnel into an ancient route. It is excluded along with inherited Underway history.

evidence.quote: tirelessly wield pick, hammer and shovel
evidence.claim: Dwarf tunnelling with excavation tools grounds the hammer image. The passage also describes cutting new tunnels, so a new tunnel does not need an invented ancient origin.

evidence.quote: inscribed them with a knife or chisel
evidence.claim: Work on hard materials grounds the chisel and carved-stone images. Combining these with a selected appearance, or depicting a tool in a named material, is a new symbolic label; it supplies no equipment, decoration or construction history.
Durazgrund is explicitly a canonical clan identity and is reserved. Its narrated ancestral weapon and deeds cannot justify a generated tunnel name.
Silver and bread are attested independent concepts, not invented product or wealth claims.
The glossary distinguishes a musical horn from horn material, and attests road and thunder. Selected nouns remain literal word senses inside adapted labels.
The selected moonlight sense and the printed material, shadow, work and sunrise nouns add distinct concepts. No generic machine, dawn-direction, geology or ancestry meaning is invented.

The conjunction explicitly pairs two reviewed images. Thrag means wound, Thrynaz includes laws, Tiwaz includes rest and Skaud includes song. These are not new translations for hospital, government or tavern.
